references.text: Repeats the same truth that the Lord is God in heaven and on earth, and that there is no other
The famous Shema which affirms that the Lord is one, the foundational confession of monotheism
God himself declares that he is the only one, and that there is no god beside him
The Lord declares that he is God and that there is no other, no god besides him
The Lord who created heaven affirms that he is God and that there is no other
God declares that he is God and that there is none like him
Solomon's prayer that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord is God and that there is no other
The scribe confirms that God is one and that there is no other besides him
Paul affirms that there is only one God, the Father, and that there is no other god
Affirms that there is one God and Father of all
